title: Summer STEM Bridge Program
who_text: Idaho residents or students at an Idaho high school, at least 16, who are sophomores, juniors, or seniors
description: Over eight weeks in Idaho Falls you take two college classes and earn 5 to 6 college credits, with field trips to Idaho National Laboratory. Tuition, fees, books, and materials are covered by grants, scholarships, and state funding. In 2026 it ran June 2 to July 23, with registration finishing in May.

title: Idaho Legislature Internship
who_text: College students approved by their school who have a faculty sponsor to oversee the internship
description: Interns work at the Idaho State Capitol in Boise during the 2027 legislative session, which starts January 11, 2027 and runs into late March or early April. The internship is unpaid, but you see how state laws are made up close.
